class.name: SteamWorkshopQuery
class.brief_description: Branchable filters and paging for the active app's ready-to-use Workshop items.

method.name: after
method.description: Returns a branch using the exact [member SteamWorkshopPage.next_cursor] from the same filters and sort. An empty cursor starts from the first page. [param cursor] supports up to 255 UTF-8 bytes.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Use [code]await query.fetch()[/code] to receive a [SteamWorkshopPageResult]. Requests up to 50 items for the active app. A stopped client settles pending observation with [constant ERR_SKIP].

method.name: search
method.description: Returns a branch that matches text in item titles or descriptions and starts at the first page. An empty string clears the text filter. [param text] supports up to 255 UTF-8 bytes.

method.name: sort_by
method.description: Returns a branch with explicit sorting and starts at the first page. Browsing defaults to [constant RATING], and a text search defaults to [constant RELEVANCE].

method.name: tagged
method.description: Returns a branch requiring the additional tag and starts at the first page. A branch supports up to 16 tags, each between 1 and 255 UTF-8 bytes.

constants.constant: Ranks matches by text relevance. A search term is required.
Ranks ready-to-use items by Steam vote popularity.
Sorts items from newest to oldest publication.
